stackDivergence.rationale: Task118 adds original normal20Length base ratios/minimal pair table/getConversionMulDiv/convert/toTwips and Tools convertTwipToMm100 over shared SAL64 bounds. BigInt selects integral N and exact signed64 rounding/preconditions; number selects floating N even for numerically integral doubles. No value-based type guessing, memory library or generic ownership mechanism. Native positive-factor/index/overflow assertions have explicit checked host errors only, not native abort/ABI certification. Immutable constexpr table positivity/product/nonzero-gcd assertions are source-proven static invariants rather than runtime private fault cases. Saturating/status overloads and other Tools helpers remain pending. Writer existing LR owner reuses seven exact integer conversions; fractional font-relative rounding remains unchanged. SvxMarginItem actual default20twips on four signed16 sides, explicit/copy/Clone/get/set/payload equality and complete member Any/metric transport preserve original upper-only admission and negative narrowing. SvxOrientationItem actual enum/rotation+stacked/copy/Clone/typed enum output and enum-integer input use original shared SfxEnumItem/CPPU/CellOrientation normal generated type binding; no generator execution or fake provider. Exact9000/27000 angles are matched without modulo normalization, stacked wins. Calc143uses the actual margin default/real pooled copies and existing rotation/stacked values. Native locale/presentation/diagnostics/caches/invalid domains/ABI/fullDocPool/document/config/storage/UI/ODS remain pending/excluded. Existing metadata history/status retained without broad parity promotion. Latest user instruction supersedes task121cadence: full regression at minimum real document/cell/UI-contract and ODS load/save readiness, repair then pausegoal. Goalactive; no full suite now.
